name: Hijiribe Ruri
source: Hijiribe Ruri is a popular celebrity. After her family went broke following the collapse of the family business, Ruri became a makeup artist and was in charge of Heiwajima Kasuka's vampire makeup in his debut TV show. She later became a popular idol, starting out as a model for cosmetic products before moving on to show business.
